title: The Personal Library of Root Logos
principle: A book is a bounded executable arrangement of a living publication. It preserves a refraction without claiming to contain or conclude the source.
minting: Books are not minted. Individual writings may carry optional onchain receipts; volumes compile their publicly witnessed states without acquiring them.

volumes.title: At the Threshold of Weaving
volumes.subtitle: Four writings on execution, incompleteness, becoming, and inhabitation
